cron_observation.finding: The queue failure is not absence of a claim function. Existing tasks and bridge notes show repeated missing provider-secret errors and expired leases.

rls.remediation: Do not blanket-enable RLS without mapping legitimate service access and policies. Review grants as well as policies.

do_not: Add another queue, ledger, orchestrator, or task factory.
Create more tasks merely to keep the system busy.
Reset exhausted attempts without fixing the provider dependency.
Promote model assessments to economic truth.
Allow the worker to perform external actions, outreach, purchases, publishing, or fulfillment.
do: Use the existing queue and lease-fenced RPCs.
Use the local LM Studio worker for assessment generation when the operator machine is online.
Require the local model to pass JSON contract validation before writing an assessment.
Write a local SHA-256 proof artifact for each completed task.
Keep payment, buyer, fulfillment, and revenue truth unchanged unless independent external evidence exists.
Run the canonical 777 CI workflow and verify the run ID, commit SHA, status, conclusion, and test step before calling CI healthy.

local_worker_contract.local_model: LM Studio OpenAI-compatible endpoint, default http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1
local_worker_contract.model_selection: LMSTUDIO_MODEL if set, otherwise first model returned by /models
guardrails: Processes existing tasks only; never seeds or manufactures tasks.
Uses existing bridge claim, fenced assessment, and bridge completion RPCs.
Requires valid lease and matching run_lease.
Does not make external requests except local LM Studio and configured Supabase API.
Does not claim revenue or authorize consequential actions.
